name: Yuugatou
source:
Early Showa period. 
The only daughter of large conglomerate and a an ordinary student spend happy days at the summer resort. A spree of serial murders shocks the town. Death and armed agitated inhabitants fill the streets. It's going to be okay as long as we are together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
昭和初期。
大企业的独生女和一名普通的学生在避暑山庄度过了快乐的日子。一场连环杀人案震惊了小镇。街道上充满了死亡和武装的愤怒居民。只要我们在一起就好了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
